keyTips.text: Control the lane brushes so you can surprise opponents with Shield Vault and keep them away from minions.
Poke with Comet Spear to build a health lead, then all-in once the opponent is low enough to finish.
Level six is more valuable for roaming than for winning every lane all-in; use Grand Starfall to create plays elsewhere.

tips.text: At level one, work from a brush and choose poke or an all-in based on the opening rather than walking into a prepared fight.
Hold Aegis Assault for a committed trade where blocking damage turns the fight; Pantheon is vulnerable while it is unavailable.
Keep the wave even or slightly on your side so you can run the enemy down while staying safer from ganks.
After taking the bot tower or when the lane goes quiet, treat the unlocked ultimate as a roaming tool and look for the first cross-map opening.
Use Grand Starfall for cross-map plays after a recall or when another lane needs help.
Lock down a high-priority target and work with the jungler to pick off the enemy jungler or support.
Flank with the ultimate during an ongoing fight so enemies have less time to react to the arrival.
Use extra roaming speed from boots to create more plays across the map and convert that movement into pressure.
A second ultimate rank mainly reduces its cooldown, so use the more frequent windows to set up picks rather than expecting a larger utility jump.
In late game, look for picks instead of forcing a front-to-back five-versus-five; Pantheon's damage falls off as opponents buy defenses.
Stay near neutral objectives and track the enemy jungler so you can contest or protect the objective instead of being caught on the opposite side.
Use fog of war to reach enemy carries from an unexpected angle; if the team needs a frontline, a tankier build can fill that role.
Avoid starting an ultimate engage so far ahead of the team that nobody can follow up; the landing position can leave Pantheon exposed.
If Grand Starfall is unavailable, delay a late-game fight or disengage rather than committing without the main engage tool.

itemization.text: Take Press the Attack, Triumph, Legend: Haste, Coup de Grace, Cheap Shot, and Relentless Hunter as the 26.21 support rune page.
Build Bloodsong, Plated Steelcaps, Umbral Glaive, Eclipse, and Black Cleaver as the 26.21 support core.
Choose Sundered Sky as the alternative to Eclipse when the game calls for its critical strike and healing as a bruiser damage-and-sustain option.
Start W, Q, E, then max Comet Spear first followed by Shield Vault and Aegis Assault, upgrading Grand Starfall at levels six, eleven, and sixteen.

keyTips.text: Use Pantheon's early pressure to poke and threaten kills; a lead can snowball quickly.
Use Aegis Assault to block damage in a committed trade, but play more carefully while it is on cooldown because the opponent can punish that window.
Late-game picks are safer than repeated full-team fights; if Grand Starfall is unavailable, wait or disengage until the next engage window.

tips.text: Open the lane aggressively with Comet Spear pressure and threaten kills whenever the opponent offers a window.
Keep the wave even or slightly on your side so you can run an opponent down while reducing gank exposure.
Level six adds cross-map Grand Starfall plays, but it does not guarantee winning every lane all-in against a stronger enemy ultimate.
Use Comet Spear to poke or finish a low target; lane and river brush positioning can let you pressure without taking return damage.
Split for side objectives and use Pantheon's dueling strength against opponents who come to stop you.
Regroup for five-versus-five when there are no nearby objectives to take alone.
Use Grand Starfall and Shield Vault to set up picks with the team; focus high-priority targets and convert the catch into an objective.
A second ultimate rank gives a modest damage increase but lowers its cooldown, so it creates more windows for map plays.
Max Comet Spear first, then Aegis Assault, then Shield Vault, starting Q, W, E and upgrading the ultimate at levels six, eleven, and sixteen.
Pantheon is strongest when early pressure and picks let the team enter mid game with a lead; avoid letting a won lane turn into aimless fighting.
In late game, flank from fog of war to reach enemy carries, or peel for allies after using the ultimate to enter the fight.
Avoid starting an ultimate engage beyond the team's ability to follow; a landing position without allied support can leave Pantheon stranded.
When the team needs a frontline, use a tankier build and protect allies rather than forcing a backline dive.

itemization.text: Build Bastionbreaker, Plated Steelcaps, Voltaic Cyclosword, Lord Dominik's Regards, and Edge of Night as the 26.21 top core.
Take Stormraider's Surge, Manaflow Band, Transcendence, Scorch, Triumph, and Cut Down as the current rune page.
Choose Serpent's Fang as the situational replacement for Lord Dominik's Regards when you need to pressure a team with heavy shielding.
